title: Acai Banana Smoothie Bowl
description: A thick, vibrant smoothie bowl packed with frozen acai and bananas, topped with granola, fresh berries, coconut flakes, and honey.
instructions: Blend frozen acai packs, frozen bananas, and coconut milk until very thick and smooth. Use minimal liquid to keep it bowl-consistency.
Pour smoothie base into two bowls.
Arrange toppings in sections: granola, blueberries, strawberries, and kiwi slices.
Scatter coconut flakes and chia seeds over the top.
Add a dollop of almond butter to each bowl.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.
author: Chef Luna
